effect_description_eng:
While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [CS] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Until your opponent's turn ends, give 1 of their Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) and it can't activate [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effects. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When one of your [CS] trait Digimon attacks, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Until your opponent's turn ends, give 1 of their Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) and it can't activate [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effects.
